subject: Tournament challenges must mint their own flag, not reuse the box's
description: ROOT FIX behind the deliverFlag guard. Mallory PROVED (emulator, 6/6, 2026-09-19) a harvest-and-reuse scoring exploit: the console's Import-from-Boxes path copies flag_registry/{boxId}.flags[id] VERBATIM into a challenge (_app/admin/console.html:1655) - the same field deliverFlag reads (functions/index.js:682) - so a challenge secret IS the box's public flag, differing only by salt. Consequence today: the guard must keep 'ended' in its predicate, which permanently strips flag delivery from any public arena box a tournament ever touched (c1-data-nexus-breach, since 2026-03-25). Dropping 'ended' was VOTED DOWN 2026-09-19 because it converts that degradation into a live scoring exploit. Fix: mint a fresh flag value per challenge at import time, store its hash in flagSecrets, leave the box's own flag untouched. Then disclosure helps no competitor and no arena box is ever degraded. Engine 1 already does this (_tools/engine1/provision/mint-flag.sh); the console import path does not.
